title: Compatible pullback sheaves form a system and become constant on a cone
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with an arbitrary cone $(X,(p_i:X\to D_i))$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $T$ be a scheme, $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $v_i:D_i\to T$ morphisms satisfying $v_j=v_i\circ D(f^{op})$ for every $f:i\to j$. Let $v:X\to T$ satisfy $v=v_i\circ p_i$. Use inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and their canonical composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Put $F_i=v_i^{-1}G$, and let $a_f:D(f^{op})^{-1}F_i\xrightarrow{\sim}F_j$ be the inverse of the composition comparison transported by the specified equation for $v_j$. Let $b_i:v^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}p_i^{-1}F_i$ be the forward composition comparison transported by the specified equation for $v$. Then (1) $a_{1_i}$ equals the inverse-image identity comparison, with transport along $D(1_i)=1_{D_i}$; (2) the $a_f$ satisfy the inverse-image cocycle law for every composable pair, including the comparison between the inverse image along the composite transition and $D(g^{op})^{-1}D(f^{op})^{-1}$; (3) the transition $p_i^{-1}F_i\to p_j^{-1}F_j$ obtained from the cone equation and $p_j^{-1}(a_f)$ becomes the identity of $v^{-1}G$ under $b_i,b_j$. Equivalently these comparisons present the pulled-back sheaves as the constant diagram with value $v^{-1}G$. No limiting, directedness, compactness or separatedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For the identity arrow use the left unit law upperStarComp_id_left from [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The fully proved private helper upperStarComp_inv_of_eq_id performs equality induction on an endomorphism h equal to the identity and evaluates the inverse of this unit law at G. Applying it with h = D.map (identity at op i), the equality D.map_id and wv i i (identity at i) gives exactly the transported identity comparison. All hypotheses and equality transports are retained.

Evaluate the existing component associativity law upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Pasting, a proved rearrangement of the coherence in [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]) on D.map g.op, D.map f.op and v i, with named composites D.map (f followed by g).op, v j and v k. Supply D.map_comp, wv i j f and wv i k (f followed by g). The law says the forward comparison for the first pair followed by the pullback of phi f is phi (f followed by g) followed by the forward comparison for g. Cancel that last isomorphism using Iso.eq_comp_inv and reassociate to obtain precisely the cocycle equation.

Apply the same component associativity law from [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] to the cone leg at j, D.map f.op and v i, with named composites the cone leg at i, v j and vLimit. Supply the reversed cone equation d.w f.op, wv i j f and wLimit i. Compose the resulting equality on the left with eS i hom and on the right with eS j inverse. Associativity and the hom-inverse identities cancel both comparisons, leaving the identity of the pullback along vLimit. This is S.map f because S is the constant functor.

lean.statement:
theorem compatiblePullbackSheafSystem
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (d : Cone D)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (v : ∀ i : I, D.obj (op i) ⟶ T)
    (wv : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), v j = D.map f.op ≫ v i)
    (vLimit : d.pt ⟶ T) (wLimit : ∀ i : I, vLimit = d.π.app (op i) ≫ v i) :
    let F := fun i : I ↦ (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v i)).obj G
    let φ := fun {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) ↦
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op) (v i)
        (v j) (wv i j f)).inv.app G
    let K := (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} vLimit).obj G
    let S : I ⥤ Sheaf d.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      (Functor.const I).obj K
    let eS := fun i : I ↦
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (d.π.app (op i)) (v i)
        vLimit (wLimit i)).app G
    (∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i)) ∧
    (∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), φ (f ≫ g) =
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
        (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g) ∧
    (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), S.map f =
      (eS i).hom ≫
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (d.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
        (d.π.app (op i)) (d.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (d.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eS j).inv)
